proposal.expected_benefit: This will strengthen the defense by ensuring that even if an adversary finds a way to bypass one mechanism, they cannot bypass the entire audit and compliance framework, thereby reducing the risk of unauthorized transactions.
proposal.problem: The defense does not explicitly address the possibility of bypassing audit mechanisms or the potential for replay attacks through alternative channels.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to ensure that all audit and compliance controls are non-negotiable and that replay protection is enforced across all transaction types, not just those involving POI.
proposal.title: Ensure Non-Negotiable Audit and Compliance Controls
verification_tests: Test audit-before-execution across all transaction types
Validate replay protection mechanisms for non-POI transactions
Verify that compliance gates cannot be overridden under any circumstances
